name: TEF-Notes
description: Notes and tasks with a web app that works offline and an optional AI assistant.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The notes database (pb_data/), the agent's search index (agent/), the speech model (stt/), the key files (keys/) and the push key (state/). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: TEF Notes web app, API (/api), agent (/agent) and PocketBase admin (/_/), published on host as 6718

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open TEF Notes at, like http://192.168.1.20:6718 or your https address. It is only shown in the logs; the app works from any address.

variables.name: TEF_NOTES_PROVIDER
variables.description: The AI model provider for the assistant and clip write-ups: deepseek, anthropic, openai, xai, qwen, zai or ollama.

variables.name: TEF_NOTES_LLM_KEY
variables.description: Your API key for that provider. Leave it empty to use TEF Notes without the AI assistant (Ollama needs none).
